name: A Donation of Wool
summary: Darnassus is accepting wool cloth donations to support its stores. Your contribution earns recognition for your generosity.

sections.title: Wool Stores
sections.body: Darnassus is accepting donations of wool cloth. The city needs sixty pieces from you, and expects to gather the rest of its stores from others across the realm. Your donation brings full recognition for your generosity.

faq.answer: Darnassus is accepting donations of wool cloth.

faq.q: How much wool do I need to donate?
faq.answer: The donation is sixty pieces of wool cloth.
Darnassus is gathering wool cloth to support its stores.

faq.q: What do I get for donating wool?
faq.answer: A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth earns full recognition from Darnassus for your generosity.
